headline: Dixon Technologies (India) Limited: News Verification
sum: News Verification - The Exchange has sought clarification from Dixon Technologies (India) Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Dixon Tech shares rise 5% amid buzz of govt nod for Vivo JV; JPMorgan retains  overweight  rating.…
detail: News Verification - The Exchange has sought clarification from Dixon Technologies (India) Limited with respect to recent news item captioned Dixon Tech shares rise 5% amid buzz of govt nod for Vivo JV; JPMorgan retains  overweight  rating. The response from the Company is attached.
